# Active maintenance: a guide

> How we actively maintained the replication archives of published papers with AI coding agents: the stages, the rules for judging errors, the output table schemas, known traps, and instructions written for agents.

The whole guide in one file: https://active-maintenance-aec.github.io/guide/llms-full.txt
